job.title: Electrical commissioning Engineer
job.description:

You will oversee and run large scale commissioning programs in their entirety within Data Centre environments.

The nature of this role is to provide engineering and technical support to plan, schedule, coordinate and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical data centre facilities. You will be involved in all stages of commissioning, from early design, managing commissioning scripts, witness testing and logistics.
  
Requirements:
  • Electrically qualified qualified (trade or tertiary)
  • Data Centre experience preferred but not essential
  • Excellent documentational skills, strong communicator and technically minded.
  • Must know how to present complex ideas to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced environment and remain calm under pressure
What’s on Offer:
  • Major Sydney-based data centre projects
  • Competitive remuneration based on experience with a salary guide of $130k - $150k + super + bonus
  • High earning potential and extensive future growth opportunities
This is a great opportunity to join the rapidly expanding & developing world of Data Centres. If you feel like you meet the requirements, please submit your application for consideration.

job.title: Mechanical Engineering Lead
job.description:
The Engineering Lead (Mechanical) will serve as the key mechanical  engineering authority for our datacenter platform. As an individual contributor, you will provide technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from site selection and engineering design through construction, commissioning, and operations.

The role will work closely with internal teams, consultants, contractors, and clients to develop practical, reliable, and technically sound solutions that support project delivery and meet customer requirements.

What you'll do
  • Provide mechanical engineering input during site evaluation and acquisition activities.
  • Identify potential engineering risks, constraints, and development requirements.
  • Review engineering designs and technical submissions to ensure quality, compliance, and alignment with project requirements.
  • Provide technical support throughout construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
  • Support project teams in troubleshooting and resolving mechanical and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Work collaboratively with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, vendors, and clients.
  • Lead technical discussions, design reviews, coordination meetings, and engineering workshops.
What you'll need
  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 5–10 years of experience within data centres, critical infrastructure, construction, or engineering environments.
  • Proven experience supporting projects across design, construction, commissioning, and operations.
  • Strong mechanical engineering knowledge with excellent technical coordination and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

job.title: Electrical Engineering Lead
job.description:
The Engineering Lead (Electrical) will act as the primary electrical engineering authority for our data centre platform. You will provide technical leadership and engineering expertise across the complete project lifecycle — from site selection and technical due diligence through design, construction, commissioning, and operations.

The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, utility providers, and clients to develop robust, reliable, and scalable electrical solutions that support successful project delivery and meet operational and customer requirements.

What you'll do
  • Review technical studies, assessments, and due diligence reports.
  • Identify key risks, constraints, and development considerations related to electrical infrastructure.
  • Coordinate electrical engineering activities across design, solutioning, construction, and commissioning.
  • Manage technical issues, changes, and project risks.
  • Ensure solutions meet operational, reliability, and business requirements.
  • Provide technical advice to project teams during construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
  • Assist with troubleshooting and resolution of electrical and critical power infrastructure issues.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, consultants, contractors, utility providers, and vendors.
  • Monitor project progress and communicate technical risks and issues.
  • Drive innovation, process improvements, standardisation, and capture lessons learned.
What you'll need
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 5-10 years of experience in data centres, critical infrastructure, construction, power systems, or engineering environments.
  • Experience supporting projects through design, construction, commissioning, and operations.
  • Knowledge of critical electrical systems, including utility power, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, and power distribution systems.
  • Strong technical coordination, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

job.title: MEP Project Manager
job.description:
As a Project Manager, you will take overall responsibility for the operational delivery of assigned projects, ensuring that all safety, technical, commercial and management requirements are successfully met from the pre-bid and pre-construction stages through to practical completion.

What you'll do

  • PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification is required.
  • Degree in Project Management, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), Business Administration or a related discipline is preferred. Equivalent extensive trade or industry experience will also be considered.
  • Certified Data Centre Project Manager (CDCPM) or demonstrated project management experience within the data centre sector is highly desirable.
  • Significant international project delivery experience, preferably within data centres or other mission-critical environments.
  • Proven experience managing projects within construction and M&E environments.
  • Strong understanding of the data centre industry and associated mission-critical services.
  • Strong commercial and financial awareness, including understanding of project profitability, P&L and commercial costing.

job.title: Operations Director
job.description:
Operations Director - APAC
Singapore

  
Most operations leaders in this space inherit a machine that already runs itself. This is the opposite. You would be building the delivery engine for a proven European data centre specialist as it scales across APAC, with the autonomy to set how projects get delivered rather than administering someone else's process.

You sit directly alongside the VP for the region, so decisions get made in a conversation rather than through three layers of committee. The scope is genuinely broad. Manpower planning, supply chain, logistics, commercial control, HSE and the client relationship all sit with you, which is unusual for a role at this level and hard to find once you have grown past single project delivery.

The market backdrop does the rest. APAC data centre demand is not slowing, and this business already has the European track record, client relationships and delivery standards to win the work. What it needs is someone to make regional delivery repeatable and profitable. Get that right and you own the operational blueprint for a region that is only going to get bigger, with the team you build under you.

Hybrid working will give you the flexibility to balance time in the office with regional travel, while a generous bonus scheme and full healthcare insurance will reward your contributions. You'll also gain real ownership of a growing business in Asia, backed by a global brand.

What you’ll do

Lead regional operational and project delivery activity across data centre projects in APAC. Working alongside the Executive Vice President (APAC), you’ll be accountable for operational excellence, customer satisfaction, profitability and sustainable growth.

Provide both strategic and hands-on leadership across project operations, manpower planning, subcontractor management, logistics, materials, HSE, quality, commercial control and the customer interface, so that projects are delivered safely, on time, on budget and to the required quality standard.

What you’ll need
  • Extensive operations, construction or engineering experience, ideally within data centres or a comparable technically demanding sector
  • Proven track record managing multiple concurrent projects and operational teams
  • Commercially astute, with a strong grasp of project delivery, scheduling and cost control
About the company

A specialist data centre fit-out, MEP construction and managed services business, operating to the highest standards across Europe and now scaling its presence in APAC. The business has built its reputation on quality of delivery, long term client retention and a genuinely robust health, safety and wellbeing culture, and continues to broaden its service offering in line with client needs. 

Please click the ‘Apply’ button. Don’t worry if your CV isn’t up to date. Just send what you have and we’ll deal with that later.

job.title: Construction Manager
job.description:
As a Construction Manager, you will lead on the ground delivery of DataCenter Facility Development in Johor Bahru, with occasional regional travel. You will own construction execution across high-density, mission-critical environments driving safety, quality, schedule certainty, and disciplined delivery across multiple contractors and specialist vendors.

This is a hands-on site leadership role with strong accountability for construction performance, interfaces, and readiness for commissioning and handover.
 
What you'll do
  • Lead site-based construction delivery for AI / high-density data center infrastructure (power, cooling, white space fit-out, containment, enabling works).
  • Direct multiple contractors and vendors across MEP, CSA, controls/BMS, fire, security, network readiness, and specialist packages.
  • Own construction planning and daily execution: site logistics, access control, permits, RAMS, ITP compliance, inspections, and progress verification.
  • Drive interface management and sequencing across trades to protect critical milestones and remove blockers fast.
  • Maintain strict quality discipline: NCR management, corrective actions, punch list closure, progressive turnover.
  • Lead safety performance and culture: toolbox talks, audits, incident management, and corrective/preventative actions.
What you'll need
  • 5 -8 years' experience leading data center and/or mission-critical construction delivery.
  • Proven leadership managing large multi-trade teams and contractors in high-pressure environments.
  • Strong knowledge of MEP/critical systems construction and the construction-to-commissioning handover process.
  • Deep understanding of construction controls: QA/QC, ITPs, inspections, NCRs, change control inputs, punch lists, and closeout.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication—able to run site cadence and hold teams accountable.
  • Competency with reporting and project tools (MS Office) and exposure to systems like Aconex/Procore/ACC/SharePoint.
  • Based in Johor Bahru (or able to relocate) and willing to travel occasionally.

job.title: Fire Safety Engineer
job.description:
Based in Taiwan, the HSE & Fire Safety Engineer will be responsible for developing, implementing and monitoring the HSE and Fire Safety systems across the datacentre facility. The role will ensure compliance with Taiwan statutory requirements, corporate policies and industry best practices, while driving a proactive safety culture and maintaining high standards of health, safety and environmental performance throughout the facility.

What you'll doing:
  • Ensure compliance with Taiwan HSE and fire safety regulations, corporate policies, and client requirements.
  • Develop, Implement, maintain and periodically review HSE and Fire Safety Management Systems.
  • Manage the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system and review work activities, including but not limited to Hot Work, LOTO, Working at Height and Confined Space Entry.
  • Ensure contractors, vendors and employees comply with site HSE and fire safety requirements, include but not limited to ensure they have attended the safety induction and toolbox meetings.
  • Conduct HSE inspections, audits, risk assessments and workplace safety observations and ensuring timely closure of identified findings.
  • Organize HSE and fire safety training, awareness campaigns and safety improvement initiatives.
  • Perform any other HSE, Fire Safety or compliance duties assigned by management.
What you'll need
  • Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Management, Fire Safety or related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant HSE, Fire Safety or Facilities Management experience, preferably in mission-critical facilities or datacentres.
  • Knowledge of ISO 45001/CNS 45001, ISO 14001, Permit-To-Work (PTW), Risk Assessment, Incident Investigation and Emergency Response.
  • Certified Fire Safety Manager in Taiwan.
  • Good communication and coordination skills in English and Mandarin are preferred.

job.title: IT/OT Infrastructure & Operations Engineer
job.description:
As an IT Infrastructure & Operations Engineer, you will be responsible for hands-on management of all DC sites to ensure that all components of the technical infrastructure are in compliance with KDCH Operational Technology (OT) Standards.

What you will do:
  • Manage and support technical infrastructure including VMware, Windows Servers, Active Directory Domain Controllers, and Backup/Recovery systems.
  • Provide operational support for OT LAN/WAN environments and enforce cybersecurity controls, including firewall administration, aligned with Incident and Problem Management processes.
  • Lead and support IT and OT projects such as Office 365 deployment, video conferencing systems, industrial control IT systems, and cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Perform proactive maintenance including Windows/Linux patching (both security and feature updates) and ensure backup and recovery readiness.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation for servers, storage, backup systems, LAN, security, and configuration details.
  • Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for ongoing server and infrastructure management. 
Technical Scope & Weightage
  • Network & Security (35%): Cisco switches, Fortinet/Palo Alto firewalls, WAN/LAN.
  • Enterprise IT/OT Systems (40%): HP/Dell servers, Windows OS, Domain Controllers, Azure Cloud administration, enterprise storage, and backup systems.
  • Patch Management & Backup/Recovery (10%).
  • VMware Administration (10%).
  • ICS/OT Vendor Systems (5%).
What you will need: 
  • Diploma/Degree in IT, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience in managing DC networks including LAN, WAN, WiFi, and firewalls.
  • 8-10 years of experience in Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware, Azure Cloud, and security products.
  • Strong experience in IT/OT environments within data centres supporting systems like BMS, DCIM, EMS.
  • Knowledge of enterprise servers, storage platforms, and backup solutions.

job.title: Construction Planner
job.description:
Construction Planner - Data Centre Projects
Salary $150,000 - $180,000 + super
Construction Planner – Data Centre Projects (Melbourne)

As Construction Planner, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining detailed construction programs, coordinating with project and site teams, and ensuring delivery timelines are met.   • Integrate schedules with procurement, design, and subcontractor activities.
